 Nicola Coughlan and J.K. Rowling 
 Getty/HBO 
 Nicola Coughlan has said she plans to boycott HBO ‘s Harry Potter series, despite adoring J.K. Rowling ‘s books as a child.
 The Bridgerton and Derry Girls star has previously disagreed with Rowling’s views on transgender rights. Asked about the issue by The Observer newspaper on Sunday, Coughlan doubled down.
 “I will not be watching the new Harry Potter show and I would never be in it. Look, I know people that are involved in those shows, and they’re nice people and whatever, but it’s not for me,” she said.

 Coughlan clashed with Rowling in 2025, when the author posted a picture of herself smoking a cigar after the UK’s Supreme Court ruled that the legal definition of a woman is based on biological sex. “I love it when a plan comes together,” Rowling wrote on X/Twitter.
 Watch on Deadline 
 Following the post, Coughlan shared an article from The Cut on her Instagram Story, with the headline “This Is a New Low for J.K. Rowling.” She added: “Keep your new Harry Potter lads. Wouldn’t touch it with a 10 foot pole.” 
 Rowling then claimed not to know who Coughlan was, nor Pedro Pascal. “Me, I could believe,” Coughlan told The Observer. “But Pedro Pascal? You know who Pedro Pascal is, girl. Like, please.”
 Commenting on the Supreme Court ruling last year, Coughlan said: “To see an already marginalized community being further attacked and attacked in law is really stomach-churning and disgusting, and to see people celebrate it is more stomach-churning.”
 Coughlan’s remarks come as marketing for the Harry Potter series — on which Rowling serves as an executive producer — ramps up ahead of its December 25 premiere. HBO released a clip from the show over the weekend , featuring Hogwarts students tucking into their start-of-term feast after new arrivals were sorted into their houses.
 Succession duo Francesca Gardiner and Mark Mylod write and direct the Harry Potter series, respectively. Gardiner serves as showrunner and executive producer, and Mylod will direct multiple episodes in addition to serving as executive producer.
